name: ApplicantStack
niche: applicant tracking and onboarding for small and mid-sized employers
notes: Site says: "Our Growth plan allows up to 3 active job postings." Site says: "ApplicantStack works with the following partners to deliver top-rated ATS" Pricing page lists four monthly plans from $29.99 to $159.99 per month. Job boards page says job posts are uploaded to Indeed and JobTarget. Footer copyright reads Swipeclock, but no parent is stated.
